title: TIFF signature (II* / MM*)
summary: A TIFF image begins with a byte-order mark: II (0x49 0x49) for little-endian or MM (0x4D 0x4D) for big-endian, followed by the magic number 42 (0x2A 0x00 little-endian or 0x00 0x2A big-endian).
source_version: Wikipedia List of file signatures, retrieved 2026-05-29

notes: Byte 4 onward: offset to the first Image File Directory (IFD).
